Given the issue report mentioning changes in JDK 9 and a potentially bogus value returned from `getTime()`, it is likely that the discrepancy in the modify time values between the test and the actual implementation of setting the modify time in the Zip entry is causing the test failure under JDK 9.

1. Investigate the implementation of setting the modify time in the Zip entry to see how the time values are handled.
